prerequisites: No specific prerequisites. Competences from basic modules in Computer Science are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: The students can explain advanced concepts of Computer Vision.
The students can explain in-depth methods of Deep Learning and its application to visual data.
The students can implement, analyze, and apply methods and concepts of Computer Vision.
The students can develop and optimize solutions to Computer Vision problems.
The students are able to apply scientific working methods in independently recognizing, formulating, and solving problems.

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments
Oral exam (individual examination) or written exam

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two of these assignments. Grading is from 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
